messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tyler Green <tyler.green@crescenthealth.com>, Ops Team <ops@crescenthealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Crescent Health — bundled onboarding + premium support ask (initial)

Hi team,

Following up from the call this morning with Tyler and the Crescent Health ops squad — they want a bundled package to speed production rollout across 8 hospitals:

- 6 months of Premium Support (priority queue, dedicated TAM) included
- Dedicated onboarding: 4 weeks (2 engineers x 4 weeks) + custom EMR connector work (Epic HL7 interface) scoped as 120 engineering hours
- Requesting a 25% one-time discount off list for the first-year committed usage

Key commercial asks: premium support included at no additional charge and a 25% concession. They are ready to sign contingent on exec approval for the concession and SOW scope. Procurement also asked for a single SOW combining onboarding + support so they can route to legal.

I've attached a draft SOW (SOW_draft_v3.pdf) and a quick price calc (price_calc_Crescent_DEAL-7834.xlsx).

Can we get an executive review? My recommendation: approve premium support inclusion, negotiate discount to 20% and keep the custom connector as billable hours but offer first 40 hours complimentary. That keeps our implementation economics cleaner.

Next step: need an approval email that I can forward to procurement (they want it in writing).

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Crescent Health — bundled onboarding + premium support ask (internal ask + summary for exec)

Ben / team,

Thanks for the summary — filing this for deal desk / exec approval. Quick numbers from finance: list value year 1 (licenses + support) = $1,150,000. A 25% concession reduces ARR to ~$862k, which is material for a first-year newborn account.

Specific ask to executives:
- Approve inclusion of 6 months Premium Support (no charge) for the first year
- Approve one-time commercial concession up to 25% OR counter-approve 20% with 40 hours of implementation credit (recommended)
- Approve waiving professional services fees for the first 40 hours of EMR connector work (billed thereafter)

Operational notes / risk:
- Custom EMR work requires a partner with Epic HL7 experience; need to budget for additional QA (approx 40 hours) if we absorb too much of the integration cost.
- SLA exceptions: customer expects 99.9% for inference endpoints in production; will need Dedicated routing or Redwood Dedicated reservation to guarantee.

If we can get a short approval note from Vivek (or leadership) by EOD Tuesday, I can push procurement and get DocuSign ready.

PRI: Approve or propose edits — tagging Vivek for signoff.

--
Priyom Das
Senior Manager, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Crescent Health — SOW redline and legal feedback

Priyom / Ben,

Reviewed the SOW draft and attached a redline (SOW_redline_laura.pdf). High level legal points:

1) IP & Deliverables — we should avoid assigning broad IP rights for connectors; propose a license-back model for code we provide.
2) Liability cap — keep to standard Redwood cap (12 months of fees).
3) Warranty & support term — if we include 6 months Premium Support at no charge, we should explicitly limit scope to "priority ticketing, TAM coordination, and application-level triage" and exclude third-party EMR vendor support.

Commercial counter-proposal: rather than 6 months free, suggest 4 months free + documented onboarding success milestones (go/no-go) that trigger any additional complimentary support. That gives ops a chance to validate and reduces open-ended exposure.

I'll also mark the SOW to show the 40-hour implementation credit and carve-outs for Epic integration tasks.

Attaching redline.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

Team,

Approve with conditions. Final decision:

- Approve inclusion of Premium Support, limited to 4 months complimentary support as Laura suggested. Additional months may be purchased at list rates.
- Approve a commercial concession equivalent to 20% off year-one fees OR application of a 20% credit applied by RevOps (preferred).
- Approve first 40 hours of EMR connector work as complimentary professional services; hourly overage to be billable per SOW.

Rationale: this preserves a path to close while limiting long-tail support and legal exposure. Make sure the SOW explicitly defines what "Premium Support" covers and excludes third-party EMR vendor troubleshooting. Please get Procurement a single-page exec approval note (I authorize these concessions for DEAL-7834) and capture the concession in the hubspot record.

Priyom — please proceed to document the approval so Ben can return to Crescent with binding language. Monica — work with RevOps to apply the credit path and ensure revenue recognition alignment. Laura — finalize the redline and confirm the SOW language on exclusions.

Thanks,
